terms.name: Capability feasibility progression
terms.definition: An analytical sequence for describing distinct levels of practical possibility: possible → practical → repeatable → scalable. A step need not follow the preceding one automatically, and the categories are not a universal maturity model.

terms.name: Observability boundary
terms.definition: The practical limit of what a given observer or monitoring arrangement can detect, interpret, or causally connect. The limit may be known, partly understood, or itself unrecognized.

terms.name: System-level autonomy
terms.definition: A possible condition in which interactions among humans, organizations, and AI systems sustain consequential patterns no single participant meaningfully directs or can correct. It is a claim about collective operation, not necessarily autonomy of any one agent.
